facts.fact: IFC's description of the 2025 Raxio financing says Raxio operates carrier-neutral colocation data centres in Mozambique (among six other countries); no facility name or address given.
The same description says Raxio operates Tier III data centres in Mozambique, as stated by the operator's press release; no certification body is named and the facility is not named.
